title: Action by director.
bodyText: The director may maintain an action to restrain a foreign limited liability partnership from transacting business in this State in violation of this subpart.
bodyHtml: [§425-171]  Action by director.  The director may maintain an action to restrain a foreign limited liability partnership from transacting business in this State in violation of this subpart. [L 2000, c 218, pt of §1]
